title: Flatness of coefficient geometric stalks
statement: For any scheme X, coefficient ring B in the independent coefficient universe, geometric point x, and flat module sheaf F over the constant B-ring on the coefficient-sized small etale model, the B-module coefficientEtaleModuleStalk(X,B,x)(F) is flat. No finiteness, local constancy, boundedness, or Noetherianity is assumed. The constant-ring action and exact stalk are those of [def-sfb-coefficient-etale-derived-stalk], and flatness is [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules].

proof.text: Use the exact symmetric monoidal constant-scalar equivalence and its natural identification with coefficientModelFixedScalars to send the flat ringed sheaf to a flat fixed-coefficient sheaf.
The AsSmall site equivalence commutes with sheafification. Lift its presheaf monoidal structure along sheafification; as a monoidal equivalence it preserves flat objects.

Test a monomorphism of B-modules by the constant-sheaf functor. Tensor with the flat sheaf and take the exact monoidal geometric fiber. The fibers of constant sheaves identify the resulting map with stalk tensor the original monomorphism. Thus stalk tensor preserves monomorphisms; right exactness of tensor proves flatness.

theorem coefficientEtaleModuleStalk_flat
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (B : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing B]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X)
    (F : ConstantCompletion.Mod
      (ConstantCompletion.constant (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) B))
    (hF : SheafOfModules.IsFlat
      (R := ConstantCompletion.constant (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) B) F) :
    Module.Flat B ((coefficientEtaleModuleStalk X B x).obj F)
